overview.about: The Chevron Championship is the first women's major of the year, founded in 1972 and long known as the Dinah Shore. Now played at The Club at Carlton Woods near Houston, it keeps its beloved tradition of the champion leaping into the water beside the 18th green.
overview.nextEvent: The next Chevron Championship is played at The Club at Carlton Woods in The Woodlands, Texas. As the season's opening women's major, it draws a full-strength field, and the winner traditionally takes a celebratory plunge into the pond.
